_comment: Tile Palette — reusable tile types used to paint maps. Each tile carries an integer `tile_id` (the identity that map.grid cells reference), display `name`, `walkable` flag, RGB fallback `color`, and `sprite` reference into the /sprites/map/ library. Optional `flags` carry lighting metadata. Optional `interaction_type` + `interaction_data` are catalog-level defaults; per-cell instance data (this specific door leads here) lives on the map record. Trimmed down from the v1 legacy catalog to a basic outdoor + interior starter set; add more via the editor as needed. The integer `tile_id` is what gets stored in map grids, so keeping these ids stable preserves existing maps.
